title: Realized skewness from hourly returns, cross-section of 26 futures (Amaya, Christoffersen, Jacobs and Vasquez 2015)
rule: RSK = sqrt(N) * sum(r^3) / (sum(r^2))^1.5 over the hourly roll-safe returns of the past L trading days; every Friday close rank roots; long the n most negative, short the n most positive, inverse-vol (35d), held the next week; daily_book costs
judgement: current 14-sleeve book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.102
